content: Sneha Roy followed up with insurance agent Anita Sharma to process the cancellation of her health policy. Anita confirmed that there are no hidden fees or penalties, and that Sneha will receive a partial refund within 5 to 7 business days under pro-rata terms. Sneha confirmed to proceed, and Anita successfully cancelled the policy, updating the system status and sending a cancellation confirmation letter to Sneha's email.

action_items: Issue partial refund within 5-7 business days
Send cancellation confirmation letter via email
